exposure: Characteristics of medical abortion product package inserts
outcome: Identified clinical information in package inserts
Identified storage instructions in package inserts
Types of recommended doses and regimens
cohort: The study cohort consisted of 41 package inserts from mifepristone, misoprostol, and combined mifepristone-misoprostol products collected in 20 low- and middle-income countries.
finding: The medical abortion product package inserts collected from low- and middle-income countries contained inadequate storage instructions and outdated gestational age limits and regimens.
country: 20 low- and middle-income countries (specific countries not listed)
gest_age: Gestational age limits stated in the package inserts ranged from 49 days to 'first trimester'.
